name: Hermes Face
author: Pierre-Johan Goosen
description: A live agent head on your bar. One glyph says idle, thinking, speaking or failed, and holds the three things you actually reach for: left click opens the face, right click stops it mid-sentence, middle click restarts the bridge. The face is a holographic head that listens through dictation and answers in your own Hermes agent's voice, and it ships inside this repository, so one install is the whole system.

barWidget.description: Your agent's face, live: idle, thinking, speaking or failed, with open, stop and restart on one slot.
